68847-the-hollow-lens.title: The Hollow Lens
68847-the-hollow-lens.creator: Henry Leverage
68847-the-hollow-lens.description: A book by Henry Leverage. bulky, rough-voiced and disfigured by a giant scar which ran from the lobe of his right ear down to, and under, his chin. The girl who now professed to be his daughter resembled him in no particular. “Some mistake,” Fay said, rising gallantly. “I’m sure that you have taken me for some one else.”  The girl lifted her elbows from the table, opened her parasol, raised it and asked:  “Wont you sit down? I haven’t mistaken you for some one else.

arxiv-1906-00534.title: Sentiment Tagging with Partial Labels using Modular Architectures
arxiv-1906-00534.creator: Xiao Zhang, Dan Goldwasser
arxiv-1906-00534.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Xiao Zhang, Dan Goldwasser. Many NLP learning tasks can be decomposed into several distinct sub-tasks, each associated with a partial label. In this paper we focus on a popular class of learning problems, sequence prediction applied to several sentiment analysis tasks, and suggest a modular learning approach in which different sub-tasks are learned using separate functional modules, combined to perform the final task while sharing information. Our experiments show this approach helps constrain the learning process and can alleviate some of the supervision efforts.

arxiv-2111-12741.title: Probing cosmic strings by reconstructing polarization rotation of the cosmic microwave background
arxiv-2111-12741.creator: and Simone Ferraro
arxiv-2111-12741.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by and Simone Ferraro. Cosmic birefringence—the rotation of the polarization of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) photons as they travel to the Earth—is a smoking gun for axion-like particles (ALPs) that interact with the photon. It has recently been suggested that topological defects in the ALP field called cosmic strings can cause polarization rotation in quantized amounts that are proportional to the electromagnetic chiral anomaly coefficient 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , which holds direct information about physics at very high energies.

arxiv-2411-15428.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yunlei Liang, Jiawei Zhu, Wen Ye, Song Gao*. Spatial networks are useful for modeling geographic phenomena where spatial interaction plays an important role. To analyze the spatial networks and their internal structures, graph-based methods such as community detection have been widely used. Community detection aims to extract strongly connected components from the network and reveal the hidden relationships between nodes, but they usually do not involve the attribute information.

arxiv-2505-04583.description: Abstract Rehabilitation robots are often used in game-like interactions for rehabilitation to increase a person’s motivation to complete rehabilitation exercises. By adjusting exercise difficulty for a specific user throughout the exercise interaction, robots can maximize both the user’s rehabilitation outcomes and the their motivation throughout the exercise.

arxiv-2510-10171.title: Toxicity Bounds for Dynamic Liquidation Incentives
arxiv-2510-10171.creator: Alexander McFarlane
arxiv-2510-10171.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander McFarlane. We derive a slippage-aware toxicity condition for on-chain liquidations executed via a constant-product automated market maker (CP-AMM). For a fixed (constant) liquidation incentive i i , the familiar toxicity frontier ν < 1 / ( 1 + i ) \nu<1/(1+i) tightens to ν < 1 / ( 1 + i ) ​ λ \nu<1/(1+i)\lambda for a liquidity penalty factor, λ \lambda , that we derive for both the CP-AMM and a generalised form.

arxiv-2510-25801.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has recently catalyzed a wave of “MLLM-r1” approaches that bring RL to vision language models. Most representative paradigms begin with a cold start, typically employing supervised fine-tuning (SFT), to initialize the policy before RL.

arxiv-2511-03369.title: Silenced Biases: The Dark Side LLMs Learned to Refuse

arxiv-2511-03369.description: Abstract Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly widespread, especially in sensitive applications where fairness is essential and biased outputs can cause significant harm. pmc-11317455.description: BackgroundN6-methyladenosine (m6A) is the most common internal RNA modification and is involved in regulation of RNA and protein expression. AlkB family member 5 (ALKBH5) is a m6A demethylase. Given the important role of m6A in biological mechanisms, m6A and its regulators, have been implicated in many disease processes, including cancer.

pmc-11442672.title: Clinical efficacy and immune response of neoadjuvant camrelizumab plus chemotherapy in resectable locally advanced oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma: a phase 2 trial
pmc-11442672.creator: Yue-Yun Chen, Pei-Pei Wang, Yang Hu, Yong Yuan, Yu-Shang Yang, Hua-Shan Shi, Qing Hao, Zhen Lin, Jiang-Fang Tian, Yue Zheng, Ting Liu, Pan-Pan Lin, Heng Xu, Xue-Lei Ma, Li Yang, Zhen-Yu Ding
pmc-11442672.description: BackgroundNeoadjuvant immunotherapy is under intensive investigation for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC). This study assesses the efficacy and immune response of neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy (nICT) in ESCC.MethodsIn this phase II trial (ChiCTR2100045722), locally advanced ESCC patients receiving nICT were enrolled. The primary endpoint was the pathological complete response (pCR) rate.

pmc-11503342.title: Hydration Considerations to Improve the Physical Performance and Health of Firefighters
pmc-11503342.creator: Angelia M Holland-Winkler, Blake K Hamil, John A Nyland
pmc-11503342.description: Background/Objectives: Firefighters are exposed to a high level of stress as they often perform physically challenging work in hazardous environments while responsible for rescuing and keeping those around them safe. To add to this stress, they are also required to work in heavy, unbreathable personal protective equipment which promotes dehydration.

pmc-11605217.title: Size Effects in Climatic Aging of Epoxy Basalt Fiber Reinforcement Bar

The kinetics of moisture transfer was obtained in humidification and drying modes at 60 °C in samples of epoxy basalt fiber reinforcement bars: after 28 months of exposure in the extremely cold climate of Yakutsk and 30 months of exposure in the moderately warm climate of Gelendzhik.

pmc-11655609.title: MacBehaviour: An R package for behavioural experimentation on large language models
pmc-11655609.creator: Xufeng Duan, Shixuan Li, Zhenguang G Cai
pmc-11655609.description: The study of large language models (LLMs) and LLM-powered chatbots has gained significant attention in recent years, with researchers treating LLMs as participants in psychological experiments. To facilitate this research, we developed an R package called “MacBehaviour “ (https://github.com/xufengduan/MacBehaviour), which interacts with over 100 LLMs, including OpenAI's GPT family, the Claude family, Gemini, Llama family, and other open-weight models.

pmc-12427339.title: The Effect of Girth Design and Girth Tension on Saddle-Horse Pressures and Forelimb Stride Kinematics in Rising Trot
pmc-12427339.creator: David Marlin, Olivia Randell, Emma Mayhew, Roberta Blake
pmc-12427339.description: Simple SummaryHorse tack, including the girth (the strap that holds the saddle in place), can influence how comfortable and free-moving a horse feels when being ridden. This study explored how different types of girths and the tightness of the girth (tension) affect pressure beneath the saddle and the movement of the horse’s forelimbs during a rising trot.

pmc-12430344.title: Gut Microbiota and Autism Spectrum Disorders: Neurodevelopmental, Behavioral, and Gastrointestinal Interactions
pmc-12430344.creator: Zuzanna Lewandowska-Pietruszka, Magdalena Figlerowicz, Katarzyna Mazur-Melewska, Bartosz Fotschki, Joanna Fotschki
pmc-12430344.description: Background: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a complex neurodevelopmental condition characterized by social communication deficits, repetitive behaviors, and frequent gastrointestinal comorbidities. Emerging research suggests gut microbiota alterations contribute to ASD symptoms and gastrointestinal dysfunction, but detailed microbial profiles and clinical correlations remain underexplored. Methods: This study analyzed gut microbiota in 45 children aged 2–18 years diagnosed with ASD.

pmc-12688198.creator: Shannon Weatherly, Austin Chen, Laura Ziton

Attachment styles are strongly linked to emotion regulation and specific defense mechanisms across the lifespan.Understanding a patient’s defensive patterns offers a window into their underlying attachment style in clinical settings. The original 25-items BIF was translated into Italian and administered to 359 participants.

pmc-12987028.title: Adaptive Sliding Mode with Finite-Time Convergence for Synchronized Hydraulic Multi-Arm Systems
pmc-12987028.creator: Bo Gao, Fuqiang Yang, Guangwei Ji, Guanghai Yang, Yuliang Lin, Liangsong Huang

Key innovations include the integration of adaptive sliding mode control with guaranteed finite-time convergence, a distributed leader–follower framework, and a graph-theoretical communication topology for localized interactions.

pmc-13066584.title: Metatranscriptomic insights into host-microbiome interactions underlying asymptomatic COVID-19 cases

pmc-13305689.title: 急性缺血性脑卒中患者静脉溶栓治疗后早期神经功能改善的预测模型
pmc-13305689.creator: Dujie XIE, Panyao LONG, Shuntong HU, Juan HUANG, Yi YUAN, Anding ZHU, 旭芳 吴
pmc-13305689.description: 目的早期神经功能改善(early neurological improvement，ENI)对接受静脉溶栓治疗的急性缺血性卒中(acute ischemic stroke，AIS)患者预后意义重大。本研究旨在开发并验证基于机器学习的ENI风险预测模型，以期早期、准确评估AIS患者接受静脉溶栓治疗后出现ENI的概率，为临床决策提供参考。方法收集305例接受静脉溶栓治疗的AIS患者的临床资料并进行回顾性分析。比较逻辑回归、最小绝对收缩和选择算子(least absolute shrinkage and selection operator，LASSO)回归、支持向量机(support vector machine，SVM)、极端梯度提升(extreme gradient boosting，XGBoost)和随机森林5种机器学习算法的性能以筛选最优模型。采用性能最优算法从候选变量中筛选与ENI相关的关键预测因子，并据此构建可视化列线图预测模型。通过受试者操作特征曲线、校准曲线、Hosmer-Lemeshow检验和决策曲线分析(decision curve analysis，DCA)评估模型的预测准确性和临床实用性。结果在5种算法中，LASSO回归模型表现出最佳的综合性能，测试集曲线下面积(area under the curve，AUC)为0.843(95% CI 0.760~0.926)。该模型筛选出性别、入院美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表(National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale，NIHSS)评分、入院至溶栓时间、白细胞计数、淋巴细胞计数、D-二聚体水平、体重指数、血栓部位及发病至治疗时间共9个ENI的关键预测因子。基于上述因子构建的列线图校准度良好(Hosmer-Lemeshow检验P>0.05)。DCA结果表明，在较宽的阈值概率范围内，该列线图模型具有显著的临床净获益。结论基于LASSO回归构建的列线图模型对AIS患者溶栓后ENI具有较好的预测效能，可为临床个体化治疗提供辅助参考。Keywords: 急性缺血性卒中, 早期神经功能改善, 机器学习, LASSO回归, 列线图 缺血性脑卒中是指由各种原因引起的脑部血液供应障碍，导致局部脑组织发生缺血、缺氧性坏死或软化，并伴随相应神经功能缺损的临床综合征。据统计，2020年中国约有1 780万成年人罹患脑卒中，其发病率和致残率居高不下[1]。重组组织型纤溶酶原激活剂(recombinant tissue-type plasminogen activator，rt-PA)静脉溶栓治疗的应用显著改善了急性缺血性卒中(acute ischemic stroke，AIS)的治疗效果，已成为急性期血管再通的标准治疗方案[2]。然而，临床实践中发现，即使在推荐的时间窗内接受标准化溶栓治疗，仍有相当比例的患者未能获得理想的治疗效果[3]。 溶栓后早期神经功能改善作为评估溶栓治疗有效性的重要指标，通常定义为溶栓后24 h内美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表(National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale of the United States，NIHSS)评分较基线改善≥4或完全恢复。这一指标不仅反映了血管再通的即时效果，更与患者的长期功能预后密切相关[4]。研究[4-7]表明，溶栓后早期神经功能改善受多种因素影响，包括血栓组成成分、血管解剖特征、侧支循环状态以及患者的个体生物学特征。 目前，临床医师主要依据患者的基线特征、影像学表现和实验室检查结果来评估溶栓治疗的适应证，但缺乏准确预测溶栓后早期神经功能改善的有效工具。虽然多模态影像技术在评估血管状态和预测治疗效果方面显示出良好的应用前景[8]，但其复杂的技术要求和昂贵的设备成本限制了其在基层医疗机构的推广应用。因此，迫切需要开发基于常规临床资料的简便、准确的预测模型，以指导临床决策的制订。 机器学习技术凭借其强大的数据处理能力和模式识别优势，在医学预测建模领域展现出巨大潜力[9]。与传统统计方法相比，机器学习算法能够处理高维复杂数据，识别变量间的非线性关系，并在大样本数据中发现潜在的预测模式[10]。近年来，已有研究[11]尝试将机器学习技术应用于脑卒中预后预测等临床问题，取得了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，现有关于溶栓后早期神经功能改善预测的研究相对有限，且多数研究样本量较小、预测变量选择不够全面，模型的临床适用性有待进一步验证。此外，如何在保证预测准确性的前提下，构建适用于不同医疗资源条件的简化预测模型，仍是亟待解决的重要问题。 基于上述背景，本研究旨在构建基于机器学习技术的溶栓治疗后早期神经功能改善的预测模型，通过整合患者的人口学特征、临床表现和实验室指标等多维度信息，为临床医师提供准确、便捷的预测工具。该模型的建立有助于优化患者筛选策略，提高溶栓治疗的精准性，并为后续桥接治疗的时机选择提供科学依据，最终改善AIS患者的临床预后。 对象与方法 伦理声明 本研究已获得中南大学湘雅三医院伦理委员会批准(审批号：快25989)。 对象 本研究为回顾性队列研究，纳入2020年1月至2025年1月中南大学湘雅三医院卒中中心收治的接受静脉溶栓治疗的AIS患者305人。采用基于二分类结局事件的样本量计算方法进行样本量估算。假设AIS患者静脉溶栓后早期神经功能改善的发生率为47%。采用样本量计算公式 n=Zα22×P×(1-P)d2 ，其中α=0.
